verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own data-extraction paths: admins can "pull full spend exports" through MCP or the CLI, the Transactions API retrieves transaction data, and the CLI emits JSON in agent mode. That supports exporting spend data in an open, machine-readable format. However, nothing documents a complete account-wide export covering all data types (bills, receipts, cards, users, audit logs) or an offboarding path for leaving. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export covering every object type, explicit export file formats (CSV/JSON bundles), receipt/document bulk export, an offboarding or account-closure data-portability guide, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Pull full spend exports and run SQL-style analysis (admins)
`--agent` outputs JSON for scripting and AI agent consumption
You'll create an access token and call the Transactions API to retrieve transaction data.
